import json,sys,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from wire import v,envelope,stream,crypto,datagram,trace
from h import run
def T(events,**kw): return run({"traces":[trace(events,**kw)]})['traces'][0]
def ack(largest,delay,first,pairs=(),ecn=None):
    b=bytes([0x03 if ecn else 0x02])+v(largest)+v(delay)+v(len(pairs))+v(first)
    for g,r in pairs: b+=v(g)+v(r)
    if ecn: b+=v(ecn[0])+v(ecn[1])+v(ecn[2])
    return b
# ACK largest 9, first 9 -> [0,9]; then gap 0 range 3 -> high=9-0-2=7, range[4,7]
body=ack(9,0,9,[(0,3)])
evs=[{'keys':['A']}, datagram(envelope('A',0,body),auth=[0])]
r=T(evs)
print(json.dumps(r['acknowledged'][2],indent=1))
# ECN max
body=ack(9,0,9,[(0,3)],ecn=(1,5,2))
evs=[{'keys':['A']}, datagram(envelope('A',0,body),auth=[0]), datagram(envelope('A',1,ack(20,0,0,(),ecn=(7,0,9)),auth=[0])]
r=T(evs)
print('ecn',r['acknowledged'][2]['ecn'],'count',r['acknowledged'][2]['count'],'intervals',r['acknowledged'][2]['intervals'])
print('prefix',r['acknowledged'][2]['prefix'])
# hash check manual: intervals [0,10) and [21,21)
h=hashlib.sha256((0).to_bytes(8,'big')+(10).to_bytes(8,'big')).hexdigest()
print('expect hash',h, r['acknowledged'][2]['sha256'])
# ack arithmetic errors
for name,body in [('first>largest',ack(5,0,6)),('gap too big',ack(9,0,0,[(20,0)])),('range>high',ack(9,0,0,[(0,9)]))]:
    r=T([{'keys':['A']},datagram(envelope('A',0,body),auth=[0])])
    print(name,r['packets'][1]['status'],r['closed'])
